payload.author: claude
payload.body: Per-recipient asymmetric (ECDH P-256) E2EE key wrapping: AsymmetricKeyDistributor wraps the epoch key individually to each current member's public key via ephemeral-ECDH->HKDF->AES-GCM (AAD callId:epochId:recipientId), over the same opaque keyEpoch relay (no protocol change). Boundary: SYMMETRIC sender-key (FR-156) shares one room secret so a removed member can still unwrap future keys; ASYMMETRIC (FR-158) wraps per recipient with no shared secret so a dropped member gets no blob and cannot derive future epoch keys (membership-change forward secrecy, proven by tests: removed C adopts nothing + transform rejects post-removal frames while A,B succeed). MLS (RFC 9420) remains the further evolution -- log-sized re-keying + post-compromise ratchet -- and slots behind the same KeyDistributor seam without touching SFrameCipherTransform or the media path. Gates: typecheck 0, protocol 110, core 102 (96 baseline + 6 new).
